listing.name: Serial Experiments Lain (lain-psx-decompiled)
listing.summary: Attach an independently permitted, prepared Serial Experiments Lain Windows client with both owned Japanese discs already imported. Its native client runs the game in process; preserve the separate imported-disc, memory-card and mod data tree.

steps.title: Prepare both original Japanese discs upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete copy and components you are independently permitted to use. The reviewed 0.2.0 native client documents your own Japanese discs SLPS-01603 and SLPS-01604 as Redump .cue/.bin pairs. The data-track SHA1 values are 6426fbdb45f27e089af650cddb8c41929c7890de and 409668af454a0e0a33a71c1d22918d765e718608 respectively; they are not the original executable hash. Upstream import checks those identities but can also retain an unverified/modded dump with a warning. This guide qualifies only the documented source pair, not every accepted file or language modification. Finish import/setup outside Portcove and keep independent originals.

steps.title: Keep the complete native client package
steps.instruction: The inspected Lain-windows.zip contains Lain/lain.exe as an AMD64 native player with its resources and thirdparty notices. Keep the complete matching Lain directory. This is the native client using a reimplemented PlayStation SDK; an original-PsyQ byte-identical rebuild is a different build result, not the selected Windows executable. Do not select a retail PS1 executable, disc image, compiler, script or another platform’s player. No original, subtitle pack, helper or game is obtained or executed by this attachment.

steps.title: Select saved-disc direct play
steps.instruction: After both discs have been imported and settings saved upstream, select lain.exe, use its complete extracted Lain directory as working directory and set the single argument --play. Review the exact selected intent, then request Play separately. This skips the setup UI and enters the game within the selected native process using the saved discs/settings. If data is missing, complete setup outside that attached attempt before retrying. Static source/header observations do not establish native gameplay, disc swapping or dependency resolution.

steps.title: Preserve imported discs, settings and the actual card
steps.instruction: Keep the whole active data folder, normally %APPDATA%/LainNative/lain-native on Windows, including imported discs, settings.ini, memcard1.mcd, packs, mods and other player data. The card is a raw 128 KiB image; that format alone is not save-compatibility acceptance. An already established LAIN_DATA_DIR or LAIN_MEMCARD can select an external data/card path; preserve those too, and the package directory used as a fallback if no per-user path was available. This guide adds no override and performs no card import, migration, backup or deletion.

steps.title: Keep original, translation and component rights separate
steps.instruction: Preserve the upstream MIT notice, PsyCross and all thirdparty notices, including the separately linked OpenAL LGPL terms. Those grants do not provide original-game, memory-card-icon or third-party fan translation rights. The optional laingame.net subtitles are downloaded separately by upstream and are not bundled; review the exact pack’s permission and scope independently. Lua/native-plugin mods remain upstream-managed executable content, not newly trusted Portcove packages. Keep only components you are independently permitted to use.

steps.title: Maintain the external client explicitly
steps.instruction: Quit the actual game normally before upstream replacement, disc reimport, card operations or mod changes. Preserve complete independent recovery copies and review/relink changed executable bytes. Source/frontend behavior and upstream whole-game/ending/timing reports remain upstream claims; no Portcove gameplay, swap, save/reload, installed-app or Supported acceptance is asserted. Forced termination is not a save-flush guarantee. Removing registration preserves all external files; managed install/update/rollback/backup/removal are not offered.

warnings: Keep both original disc pairs and the actual imported-disc/card data root; the native client, original-PsyQ rebuild and fan subtitle packs have separate boundaries.
